ul.li: proposal (default, recommended) — every write the agent makes (create or update an artifact, create a link, record a test result) is captured as a proposal. You review and approve or reject it on the Runs page before it is applied. Nothing merges unreviewed.
direct — writes apply immediately. Reserve for low-risk, well-trusted agents.

conbody.p: Agent-drafted artifacts can also carry a draft status so generated content never silently masquerades as reviewed work.
